correctness.rationale: From Stark’s credited independent negative-hypergeometric increments X_j of canonical Knuth cycles, with mean n_j/(N_{j-1}+1) and variance n_j(N_{j-1}+n_j+1)N_{j-1}/((N_{j-1}+1)²(N_{j-1}+2)), m=N_{j-1}, a=n_j/m→∞ gives X_j/a→Exp(1), with uniform exponential tails and all moments. For a_j asymptotic exp(c(j^β-(j-1)^β)), endpoint weights vary on L_t=t^{2-β} if 1<β<2, leading sum var∼a_t²L_t/[2cβ(β-1)] and Lyapunov third-moment quotient O(L_t^-1/2). At β=2 ratios→exp(-2ck) and a uniform geometric bound yields independent exponentially weighted limit S_c in L^r for all positive moments. For β>2 the previous-increment contribution is negligible, leaving Exp(1). Explicit critical n_j=2^{j²} has mean4/3, variance16/15. Boundary β≤1 excluded. These are analytic infinite-limit arguments; finite diagnostics are corroboration.
